hook_info.warning: Approximate ordinary open S with catalog outer dimensions. Lower bend supports head and cord; upper bend is free for pulling. Not actual product CAD.

cord_info.status: Flexible-cord envelope only, not a material simulation

groove_profile: Three shallow transverse troughs: full X depth weight within +/-6 mm, quintic fade to zero by +/-7.5 mm; total 15 mm remains inside 18 mm reference hook span. Actual shoulders/contact and turn resistance must be verified.
rounding: Shallow large-radius spherical cap over inner 80% radius; C2 quintic outer-rim blend to source platform. Continuous enlarged pass-through capsule, with a small rounded upper rim.
